title: Marketplace packaging adapters
objective: Package the canonical Skill for optional Agent marketplaces through adapters without maintaining divergent Skill forks.
acceptance_criteria: Marketplace packaging remains optional and does not fork or replace the canonical Skill source.
Only verified marketplace formats are advertised.
undo_classification: Remove only generated packaging artifacts owned by the adapter.
approval_requirements: Explicit user approval before marketplace publication.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries for local processing; external failures do not trigger duplicate sends without idempotency checks.
blocking_reasons: N06, N09 and approved Issue required.
